comparison.title: Why Choose Archeris.net?
comparison.subtitle: How we compare with traditional software like Ianseo
comparison.description: Archeris is an archery scoring system built to make archery tournament management and scoring simple, fast, and accessible from any browser.
comparison.f1_archeris: Runs 100% online in your browser. Open it on any laptop, tablet, or phone without installing anything.
comparison.f1_ianseo: Desktop software. Requires installing local servers (like XAMPP/MySQL) on a host computer.
comparison.f2_archeris: Easy mobile scoring. Scorekeepers log in with a simple event PIN using phone internet or Wi-Fi.
comparison.f2_ianseo: Requires a local Wi-Fi router on the field to connect phones to the host computer's local IP address.
comparison.f3_archeris: Online self-registration. Archers sign up directly on your tournament page with slot counters.
comparison.f3_ianseo: Manual entry. Organizers collect participant lists via outside forms or emails, then import them via Excel.
comparison.f4_archeris: Automatic payment checkout (QRIS, Virtual Accounts, cards) plus manual bank receipt uploads.
comparison.f4_ianseo: Manual fee tracking. Organizers enter prices and manually mark each payment as paid in the software.
comparison.f5_archeris: Visual target board and 1-click automatic lane allocator (1A, 1B, 1C, 1D).
comparison.f5_ianseo: Standard World Archery target management configured through multiple desktop setting menus.
comparison.f6_archeris: Automatic bracket generation for individual, team, and mixed matches with instant shoot-off handling.
comparison.f6_ianseo: Supports full World Archery match formats set up directly inside the desktop database.
comparison.f7_archeris: Digital scores and bracket progress that archers and parents can view on their phones anywhere.
comparison.f7_ianseo: Results must be uploaded manually to ianseo.net or displayed on venue TVs via extra local modules.
comparison.f8_archeris: 8 ready-to-print PDFs (brackets, scoresheets, start lists) plus verified digital QR certificates.
comparison.f8_ianseo: Standard World Archery result books, qualification lists, scorecards, and bracket printouts.

comparison_page.blog_title: Why Switch from Ianseo to Archeris.net?
comparison_page.blog_p1: Ianseo has long been a popular choice for World Archery tournaments. It runs on your computer and handles standard competition scoring. However, setting it up usually means installing databases, running local servers, and connecting laptops with cables or local Wi-Fi.
comparison_page.blog_p2: Archeris makes tournament management simple and web-based. Everything from participant registration, entry fees, target assignments, to archery scoring runs directly in your browser or phone—with no server setup or networking needed.
comparison_page.summary_archeris_desc: All-in-one tournament tool: online signups, instant payments, and digital archery scoring in any browser.
comparison_page.summary_ianseo_desc: Traditional tournament software that requires local computer installation and a local Wi-Fi router on the field.
